about: Block tints: which color Minecraft's BlockColors.createDefault registers for a block. A block that matches no rule is drawn untinted even when its model has a tintindex (cherry, pale oak and azalea leaves, bamboo, the stonecutter saw). `blocks` are ids, where one `*` matches any run of characters; each must name a block of the newest baked pack (guard: tints_name_real_blocks). `legacy` lists older names of the same blocks that game versions before the rename still use. `tint_index` limits a rule to faces with that index. Kinds: grass, foliage and dry_foliage come from the pack's colormaps at plains; water, redstone (by power), stem (by age), lily_pad; {"fixed": "#RRGGBB"} is a color the game fixes. LumilioCL local change; see forks/README.md.
